valor: Angel is a warden who spends day and night in his guardhouse in a neighborhood in the north of Bogota. Despite the fact that he hasn't left in 5 months, he has everything he needs to live, in a space of no more than one square meter.
motivo: se quita lo que no es sinopsis; nada se escribe
